Welding and cutting equipment for fabricators; no building envelope or roofing overlap.

Carlisle makes building envelope products (single-ply roofing, polyiso insulation, weatherproofing, spray foam) for roofing contractors and building owners. ESAB makes welding and cutting equipment and consumables, gas control products, and inspection and monitoring technology for fabricators and industrial users. The products differ and the buyers differ. Both are manufacturers that sell through distributors, but that is not enough to make them peers.

P1.4.text: Carlisle Companies Incorporated is a leading supplier of innovative Building Envelope products and solutions for more energy efficient buildings. Through its building products businesses – Construction Materials (CCM) and Weatherproofing Technologies (CWT) – and family of leading brands, Carlisle delivers innovative, labor-reducing and environmentally responsible products and solutions to customers through the Carlisle Experience.

P1.5.text: Carlisle recently published its 2025 Corporate Sustainability Report, showcasing continued progress against its three-pillar sustainability strategy of manufacturing energy efficient products, reducing emissions, and diverting landfill waste.

P1.7.text: 15%+ FCF TO SALES Cash Generation Engine

P1.9.text: Carlisle Companies to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Results on

P1.10.text: Carlisle Launches "Made with America" Video Celebrating America's 250th Anniversary

P2.2.text: Carlisle Construction Materials (CCM) is a leading manufacturer and supplier of a complete line of premium single-ply roofing products and warranted systems and accessories for the commercial building industry, including polyiso insulation and engineered metal roofing and panel systems. This segment markets its products primarily under the Carlisle SynTec, Versico Roofing, WeatherBond Roofing, Hunter Panels, CCM Europe, Drexel Metals and PAC-CLAD Petersen brands.

P2.3.text: Carlisle Weatherproofing Technologies (CWT) is a leading supplier of integrated building envelope solutions that ensure superior building performance across both commercial and residential applications. From the tallest commercial skyscrapers to residential properties of all sizes, CWT’s advanced weatherproofing systems manage the critical flow of water, vapor, air, and energy, providing cost-effective, sustainable, and reliable solutions for buildings worldwide. Our family of trusted, leading-edge building products and solutions includes Henry ®, Insulfoam ®, Carlisle Spray Foam Insulation, and Carlisle HVAC Brands.

P1.1.text: Shaping the World We Imagine | ESAB Corporation

P1.2.text: At ESAB Corporation, we are at the forefront of nurturing the ideas that transform and propelling people into action. Experience who we are and the industries we serve today.

P1.4.text: For the last century, ESAB has been at the forefront of nurturing the ideas that transform and propelling people into action.

P1.5.text: ESAB Corporation’s three business platforms provide industry-leading solutions in connected fabrication technology, gas control and gas distribution, and advanced inspection and monitoring technologies for critical assets. Together, they help customers improve productivity, enhance quality, and protect critical assets through innovation and continuous improvement.

P1.6.text: The world leader in fabrication technology, the ESAB family of brands offers efficient solutions for every industry and process.

P1.7.text: Our global portfolio of regulators, valves, and control systems ensures safety, reliability, and consistent performance across industrial production, medical environments, and specialized scientific applications.

P1.8.text: Our integrated platform of advanced instrumentation, industrial diagnostics, automated monitoring systems, robotics, and cloud analytics helps manufacturers and asset owners enhance safety, ensure quality, and extend the life of critical infrastructure.
